torch_spyre.harness: vllm bench serve, out=256, from /work/spyre-inference. Rung 1: 10 prompts of len-64/1024/10240 (123/1083/10300 on vllm bench's scale), --max-concurrency 1. Batched: 16 prompts of the shared conc-* sets (123/1024/10300), --max-concurrency 4/8, 2 reps per back-to-back boot, cell = rep 2 (steady state). serve: vllm serve --max-num-seqs 2 (rung 1) / the rung (batched), --max-model-len 12288, --max-num-batched-tokens 512, --dtype float16 (fp16) / auto (fp8). Torch serves run only on nickm4: it is the only pod whose image libflex (2a4ac955) matches the reference venv's torch_spyre/_C.so; nickm/nickm2/nickm3 carry 68bb1ad2, which lacks flex::destroyHostComputeBuffer — the five fp8 torch legs originally split to nickm3/nickm2 moved to nickm4. Cells marked in their notes as carried from the 2026-10-18 sweep are its 2026-10-14 measurements.

decode: Short-context parity is a shared floor: both stacks stream 16.4 GB of fp16 weights per token. Measured on the card (17 Oct), one fp16 matmul streams at most ~149 GB/s, and only across all 32 cores — the cost model's 204.8 GB/s peak is not reachable — so fp16 at one request bottoms out near 110 ms/token.

Every rung-1 (single-request) scratchy cell is pending calibrated re-measurement: the rung-1 prompts recorded 1.5× their bucket server-side (207/1614/15209 tokens for parameters 128/1061/10091), so their squares are left out rather than showing values taken at the wrong length (#677). The batched cells are unaffected — both stacks ran vllm bench on the same conc-* sets. The rung-1 squares return in a follow-up, with the client calibrated so the server records 128/1061/10091.
prefill: The rung-1 TTFT squares are pending for the reason in the decode note: this sweep's rung-1 prompts recorded 1.5× their bucket (207/1614/15209 server-side), which is also why this sweep states no rung-1 TTFT deltas against 2026-10-18 (#677). The batched TTFT cells stand — both sides ran the same conc-* sets.
conc: Every batched cell is the second of two back-to-back reps on one server boot (rep 1 is reliably the slow rep — TTFT ~6–7 s vs ~2.6 s, a property of the harness); both reps are recorded in each cell's note. Decode squares prefer itl_ms (per-request median TPOT under that batch); tok_s is recorded alongside for the concurrency view. The 2026-10-18 conc-8 cells recorded no rep convention (a single bench after two warmups), so this sweep's conc-8 ~1k cells are stated against torch, never as cross-sweep deltas.

The 8b fp16 batched ~10k squares are unmeasured by design: the serve refuses at boot — max-model-len 34816 × max-num-seqs 4 needs 545 KV pages (32700 MB at 60 MB per page) against the 16384 MB budget (273 pages); at max-num-seqs 8 it needs 1089 pages (65340 MB). 8b ~10k at this max-model-len fits ≤2 concurrent seqs; left absent rather than re-run at a smaller max-model-len, which would make the cell non-like-for-like with its row.
